summary_en: Year-end dividend raised 2 yen to 22 yen (ex-special). Total FY26/12 dividend 52 yen (interim 20 + year-end 32, incl. 10 yen 35th anniversary special). Prior forecast 50 yen. Driven by H1 FY26 revenue and profit beat vs prior year; upgraded FY26 outlook.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Celsys revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The year-end dividend (期末配当) is increased by 2 yen to 22 yen per share, raising the total annual dividend to 52 yen when combined with the interim dividend of 20 yen and a 10 yen special 35th anniversary commemorative dividend. This compares to the prior forecast of 50 yen total (20 yen interim + 30 yen year-end, which itself comprised a 20 yen base and 10 yen commemorative component). The increase is attributed to stronger-than-expected results in the first half of FY26 (revenue and operating profit both up year-on-year) and an improved outlook for the full year. Management stated its commitment to continued increases in dividend amounts over the medium to long term, in conjunction with capital efficiency improvements and capital allocation suited to operating conditions.
